sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即使在黑胶唱片时代我还在夜店当DJ的时候，每晚你都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，你把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个美丽的、有50年历史的文物的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, Britain raises its terror alert to the highest level as ISIS claims credit for the bombing in Manchester.
sentences.zh: 今天，随着“伊斯兰国”宣称对曼彻斯特爆炸案负责，英国将其恐怖袭击预警级别提升至最高。

sentences.en: What happened inside the world of ISIS in the hours after the attack?
sentences.zh: 袭击发生后的几个小时里，“伊斯兰国”内部发生了什么？

sentences.en: And the former CIA director is the latest U.S.
sentences.zh: 前中央情报局局长成为最新一位

sentences.en: official to testify about Russia.
sentences.zh: 就俄罗斯问题作证的美国官员。

sentences.en: His message as he realized the presidential election was under attack.
sentences.zh: 当他意识到总统大选遭到攻击时，他传达的信息是。

sentences.en: Cut it out.
sentences.zh: 适可而止吧。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, May 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月24日，星期三。

sentences.en: In the early hours after the bombing in Manchester, we waited to find out who and why.
sentences.zh: 在曼彻斯特爆炸案发生后的最初几个小时里，我们等待着真相：是谁，为了什么。

sentences.en: That gap between an act of terror and the claim of responsibility has become a familiar, terrible kind of limbo.
sentences.zh: 恐怖行为与认领责任之间的那段空白期，已经成了一种熟悉而可怕的真空状态。

sentences.en: My colleague, Rukmini Kalamaki, who covers ISIS, explains what we aren't seeing during that time.
sentences.zh: 我的同事、负责报道“伊斯兰国”的鲁克米尼·卡拉马基解释了我们在那段时间里看不到的东西。

sentences.en: So last night, I was getting ready to go to my boot camp class.
sentences.zh: 所以昨晚，我正准备去上训练营课程。

sentences.en: And I would say 20 minutes before that, I started getting messages from a source of mine who was saying something's happened in Manchester.
sentences.zh: 大概在那之前20分钟，我开始收到一位消息人士的信息，说曼彻斯特出事了。

sentences.en: Good evening, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家晚上好。

sentences.en: We're coming on the air because there has been a deadly incident at an arena in Manchester, England.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以开始广播，是因为英国曼彻斯特的一个竞技场发生了一起致命事件。

sentences.en: Now, I get these, you know, several times a day.
sentences.zh: 现在，你知道的，我一天会收到好几次这样的消息。

sentences.en: Every time a gas canister explodes, I have sources who are sending me messages going, is this ISIS, you know?
sentences.zh: 每当有气罐爆炸，我都会有消息人士发信息问我：这会是“伊斯兰国”干的吗？

sentences.en: This could have been some sort of malfunction or explosion inside of some sort of equipment, concert equipment, arena equipment.
sentences.zh: 这可能某种设备、音乐会设备或竞技场设备内部发生了某种故障或爆炸。

sentences.en: It could have also been something more nefarious, an explosion, some sort of attack.
sentences.zh: 也可能是更邪恶的事情，比如爆炸，某种袭击。

sentences.en: At this point, we simply don't know.
sentences.zh: 目前，我们根本不知道。

sentences.en: And so I started looking at the ISIS telegram channels.
sentences.zh: 于是我开始查看“伊斯兰国”的电报群。

sentences.en: There's always chatter.
sentences.zh: 总是有各种闲聊。

sentences.en: They're always so excited when any harm comes to their so-called enemies, which is all of us.
sentences.zh: 每当他们所谓的敌人——也就是我们所有人——受到任何伤害时，他们总是异常兴奋。

sentences.en: But you can't really gauge much from that.
sentences.zh: 但你真的很难从中衡量出什么。

sentences.en: When you say telegram and you say you're looking at it in chat rooms, tell me what you mean, what is that, and what you're seeing.
sentences.zh: 当你提到电报软件，并说你在聊天室里查看时，能告诉我那是什么意思、具体是什么样的，以及你看到了什么吗？

sentences.en: So the main engine through which ISIS now propagates its propaganda as well as their claims of responsibility is an app that people have on their phone called Telegram.
sentences.zh: 目前“伊斯兰国”用来传播其宣传内容以及认领责任的主要途径，是一款人们手机上都有的应用程序，叫做电报。

sentences.en: You can download it at the App Store.
sentences.zh: 你可以在应用商店下载它。

sentences.en: So for probably two years now,
sentences.zh: 所以大概两年多了，

sentences.en: I've been following them and I've managed to infiltrate myself into these channels.
sentences.zh: 我一直在关注他们，并且成功混入了这些频道中。

sentences.en: And so I started looking at the ISIS telegram channels.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始查看“伊斯兰国”的电报群。

sentences.en: First thing I searched was Manchester.
sentences.zh: 我搜索的第一个词是曼彻斯特。

sentences.en: And what I came up with was a whole bunch of rooms that were talking about this incident.
sentences.zh: 我搜出来的是一大堆讨论这起事件的聊天室。

sentences.en: And they had translated Manchester into Arabic and were hashtagging it.
sentences.zh: 他们把曼彻斯特翻译成阿拉伯语并加上了标签。

sentences.en: So when the people in an online chat room on Telegram take the name of a city where an explosion has just happened, that hashtag alone signals exactly what to you.
sentences.zh: 因此，当电报网上的聊天室里的人们使用刚刚发生爆炸的城市名称时，仅凭这个标签，对你来说究竟意味着什么？

sentences.en: They're trying to brand it.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图给它贴上标签。

sentences.en: They're already trying to brand.
sentences.zh: 他们已经在试图贴标签了。

sentences.en: So after every single attack, it's hashtag Paris, hashtag Brussels, hashtag whatever city it is.
sentences.zh: 所以在每一次袭击之后，都会有巴黎话题标签、布鲁塞尔话题标签、无论哪个城市的话题标签。

sentences.en: They are so savvy on social media that they know the hashtag convention, right?
sentences.zh: 他们在社交媒体上非常精明，深谙标签的惯例，对吧？

sentences.en: And the second thing that they do is they try to piggyback onto other popular hashtags.
sentences.zh: 他们做的第二件事就是试图蹭上其他热门话题标签。

sentences.en: So for example, they were putting hashtag Manchester, hashtag Ariana Grande.
sentences.zh: 例如，他们加上了曼彻斯特话题标签、爱莉安娜·格兰德话题标签。

sentences.en: The performer who was singing right before the explosion.
sentences.zh: 也就是爆炸发生前正在演唱的表演者。

sentences.en: And whose fans are among the dead.
sentences.zh: 而她的粉丝也在死伤者之列。

sentences.en: So at this point, I'm seeing what I would say is a very loud burst of celebration.
sentences.zh: 所以在这个时候，我看到的可以说是一阵非常高调的狂欢。

sentences.en: They're making posters, these online posters that basically show a knife dripping with blood and an imagery of London
sentences.zh: 他们在制作海报，这些网络海报基本上展示了一把滴血的刀和伦敦的意象，

sentences.en: and messages about how they're going to bring the violence to London.
sentences.zh: 以及他们将把暴力带到伦敦的信息。

sentences.en: But at this point, there has not been an official claim by ISIS.
sentences.zh: 但此时，“伊斯兰国”尚未进行官方认领。

sentences.en: And this is something that people get very confused about.
sentences.zh: 这也是人们经常感到困惑的地方。

sentences.en: There are official ISIS channels of which one of them is called Nashir.
sentences.zh: “伊斯兰国”有官方频道，其中一个叫纳希尔。

sentences.en: Another one is called Amok.
sentences.zh: 另一个叫阿马克。

sentences.en: They're well known among people.
sentences.zh: 它们在圈内广为人知。

sentences.en: And these are digital forms?
sentences.zh: 这些是数字形式的吗？

sentences.en: These are chat rooms within Telegram.
sentences.zh: 这些是电报软件内部的聊天室。

sentences.en: So there'll be a chat room.
sentences.zh: 所以会有一个聊天室。

sentences.en: And then in there, they will put out a bulletin which has Nashir written at the top or which has Amok, their logo, written at the top.
sentences.zh: 然后他们在里面发布一份公告，顶部写着纳希尔，或者写着他们的标志阿马克。

sentences.en: And that's where the official ISIS claim of responsibility comes out.
sentences.zh: 这就是“伊斯兰国”官方认领责任的发布渠道。

sentences.en: And only once that comes out, can you say that ISIS has claimed credit for it.
sentences.zh: 只有在这个发布之后，你才能说“伊斯兰国”已经声称对此负责。

sentences.en: Where people get confused is they often take what is being put out by ISIS supporters and even perhaps by individual ISIS members.
sentences.zh: 人们容易糊涂的地方在于，他们经常把“伊斯兰国”支持者甚至可能是个别成员发布的内容，

sentences.en: And they confuse that for a statement by the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 误认为是“伊斯兰国”的官方声明。

sentences.en: Now, no group has claim responsibility.
sentences.zh: 目前，没有任何组织声称负责。

sentences.en: But does this have the markings of ISIS?
sentences.zh: 但这有“伊斯兰国”的作案特征吗？

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对有。

sentences.en: So I think it was up until about one.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为直到差不多凌晨一点左右，

sentences.en: In the morning, I kept on scanning these groups.
sentences.zh: 我一直在浏览这些群组。

sentences.en: There were a couple of fake claims that came out and I spent a lot of time basically explaining to colleagues why these were fake claiMs.
sentences.zh: 期间出现了一些虚假的认领声明，我花了很多时间向同事们解释为什么这些都是假声明。

sentences.en: What's kind of mind-blowing about it is it's suddenly like this idea that there's a fake news debate in the world of ISIS.
sentences.zh: 最让人匪夷所思的是，这突然让人觉得“伊斯兰国”的世界里也存在假新闻的争论。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so how do you cut through that to make sure that it's really ISIS?
sentences.zh: 那么你如何透过现象看本质，确保这真的是“伊斯兰国”干的呢？

sentences.en: Because I know that there's a chain of custody here.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道这里有一个证据链的问题。

sentences.en: ISIS has now carried out so many both directed and inspired attacks.
sentences.zh: “伊斯兰国”现在实施了如此之多的指派型和煽动型袭击。

sentences.en: We've had dozens of them and it's always the same.
sentences.zh: 我们已经经历了数十起，而且情况总是大同小异。

sentences.en: The claim of responsibility comes out typically through a mock, sometimes through Nashir.
sentences.zh: 认领责任的声明通常通过阿马克发布，有时通过纳希尔发布。

sentences.en: It comes out on these telegram channels.
sentences.zh: 它出现在这些电报频道上。

sentences.en: These formal ISIS-controlled channels.
sentences.zh: 这些受“伊斯兰国”正式控制的频道。

sentences.en: These formal channels.
sentences.zh: 这些正式频道。

sentences.en: It looks a specific way.
sentences.zh: 它看起来有特定的样式。

sentences.en: It's usually a mock has a particular logo and a particular background.
sentences.zh: 通常阿马克有特定的标志和特定的背景。

sentences.en: Nashir has a particular one.
sentences.zh: 纳希尔也有其特定的样式。

sentences.en: And then from there, it's translated into other languages.
sentences.zh: 然后从那里被翻译成其他语言。

sentences.en: And then it's repropagated through their radio station, through their daily bulletin.
sentences.zh: 接着通过他们的电台和每日公告重新传播。

sentences.en: I mean, they have a procedure for doing this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们有一套这样做的流程。

sentences.en: So it's actually quite homogenous.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上相当整齐划一。

sentences.en: And then you realize, okay, there's a system here.
sentences.zh: 然后你就会意识到，好吧，这里有一套系统。

sentences.en: This is not just a chance.
sentences.zh: 这绝不是偶然。

sentences.en: They're using copy and paste language, stock phrases, you know, from one claim to another.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们从一份声明到另一份声明，都在使用复制粘贴的语言和陈词滥调。

sentences.en: And how long does it usually take?
sentences.zh: 通常需要多长时间？

sentences.en: What's the pattern between attack and credit?
sentences.zh: 袭击发生和认领责任之间有什么规律？

sentences.en: Less than a day, but usually at least 12 or so hours.
sentences.zh: 不到一天，但通常至少需要12个小时左右。

sentences.en: This was 14 and a half.
sentences.zh: 这一次是14个半小时。

sentences.en: Silly question, but what happens in those 14 hours?
sentences.zh: 这是一个愚蠢的问题，但这14个小时里都发生了什么？

sentences.en: Why does it take so long?
sentences.zh: 为什么需要这么长时间？

sentences.en: We don't really know.
sentences.zh: 我们其实并不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, we have theories about it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们有一些理论推测。

sentences.en: One theory is that there's a vetting process, you know, that whoever the big man is that needs to sign off on this, whoever the editor is of the ISIS news agency,
sentences.zh: 其中一种理论是存在一个审查流程，你知道的，无论是哪个需要签字拍板的大人物，无论是“伊斯兰国”新闻机构的哪个编辑，

sentences.en: may need to sign off on it.
sentences.zh: 可能都需要签字批准。

sentences.en: And maybe that takes time.
sentences.zh: 也许这需要时间。

sentences.en: We don't know what time zone, you know, they're in.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他们处在哪个时区。

sentences.en: There's been speculation that they're in Mosul.
sentences.zh: 曾有猜测认为他们在摩苏尔。

sentences.en: There's speculation that they're in Turkey, that they're in the Middle East, that they're somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 也有猜测认为他们在土耳其、在中东、在其他某个地方。

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不得而知。

sentences.en: So the claim actually came out at 7.50 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 所以这份声明实际上是在早晨7点50分发布的。

sentences.en: The Islamic militant group ISIL has claimed responsibility for the murders.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰武装组织“伊斯兰国”已声称对这些谋杀案负责。

sentences.en: And it was using their logo, red and blue background that they typically use.
sentences.zh: 它使用了他们的标志以及他们通常使用的红蓝背景。

sentences.en: I mean, it's no secret that what they do is they wait for the media to report what has happened.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这并不是什么秘密，他们的做法是等待媒体报道发生了什么。

sentences.en: And then they take those details, the death toll, the number of people injured, and details about how it occurred, and then add their religious language around it.
sentences.zh: 然后他们采用这些细节——死亡人数、受伤人数以及事发经过的细节，并在周围加上他们的宗教语言。

sentences.en: Let's talk for a minute about what we know about the attacker himself so far in the Manchester attack.
sentences.zh: 我们花一分钟来谈谈目前在曼彻斯特袭击中我们所了解到的袭击者本人的情况。

sentences.en: Well, right now, all that we have really is an age and a name.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在我们真正掌握的只有年龄和名字。

sentences.en: Police have identified him as a man called Salman Abadi.
sentences.zh: 警方已确认他是一名叫萨尔曼·阿巴迪的男子。

sentences.en: They say he's 22 years old.
sentences.zh: 他们说他22岁。

sentences.en: We were told that he's a British national of Libyan origin.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知他是具有利比亚血统的英国国民。

sentences.en: And if you look at the types of ISIS attackers that we've seen in Europe before, he very much fits the mold.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看我们以前在欧洲见过的“伊斯兰国”袭击者的类型，他非常符合这种模式。

sentences.en: Young, early 20s, basically what I would call the 1.5 generation.
sentences.zh: 年轻，刚满20岁出头，基本上就是我所说的“1.5代”。

sentences.en: There's been reporting to show that it's the children of immigrants, the ones who are born here, not the first generation who comes, but it's their children
sentences.zh: 有报道显示，这是移民的孩子，也就是在这里出生的人，而不是第一代移民，而是他们的孩子，

sentences.en: who end up feeling somewhat isolated, caught between two worlds.
sentences.zh: 他们最终会感到有些孤立，夹在两个世界之间。

sentences.en: They don't completely fit in.
sentences.zh: 他们无法完全融入。

sentences.en: And that creates an opening for radicalization.
sentences.zh: 这就为激进化创造了缺口。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I want to talk about where this attack happened, which was Britain.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈这次袭击发生的地方，也就是英国。

sentences.en: We're in Europe.
sentences.zh: 我们在欧洲。

sentences.en: What are some of the differences when it comes to acts like this there versus the United States and the attacks that we've had here when we think about this attack?
sentences.zh: 当我们思考这次袭击时，那里发生此类行为与美国以及我们在美国本土遭遇的袭击相比，有哪些不同之处？

sentences.en: Well, one of the problems in Europe is, of course, proximity to the territory that the Islamic State controls.
sentences.zh: 好吧，欧洲的问题之一，当然是靠近“伊斯兰国”控制区的地理位置。

sentences.en: It's much easier from Europe to jump in a bus or jump in a ferry if you're in England and make your way overland in order to reach ISIS territory.
sentences.zh: 如果你在英国，从欧洲坐上大巴或轮渡，通过陆路前往“伊斯兰国”领土要容易得多。

sentences.en: In America, we are insulated by an enormous body of water.
sentences.zh: 在美国，我们被一片汪洋大海所庇护。

sentences.en: And a second issue is that in Europe, there have been such large numbers of people that have gone, hundreds and hundreds, from France, from Belgium, from Britain.
sentences.zh: 第二个问题是，在欧洲，有如此庞大数量的人前往过那里，来自法国、比利时、英国的人数多达数百上千。

sentences.en: And as a result, you have basically pools of people that can act as peer-to-peer recruiters.
sentences.zh: 因此，基本上你拥有了一群可以充当点对点招募人员的群体。

sentences.en: These are people that were in your neighborhood that you knew or they're maybe the brother of your best friend or they're actual human beings that you can then talk to online
sentences.zh: 这些人曾是你的邻居、你认识的人，或者可能是你最好朋友的兄弟，亦或是你可以通过网络与之交流的真实人类，

sentences.en: and who help you move into violence.
sentences.zh: 他们会协助你走向暴力。

sentences.en: In America, there has been some peer-to-peer recruiting, but much less.
sentences.zh: 在美国，虽然也有一些点对点招募，但要少得多。

sentences.en: Here, the recruitment has mainly been digital.
sentences.zh: 在这里，招募主要通过数字化方式进行。

sentences.en: And, of course, that's a higher bar.
sentences.zh: 当然，那是一个更高的门槛。

sentences.en: So you're saying the physical proximity of ISIS recruiters in Europe is a more compelling vehicle to turn someone into an attacker willing to give up mostly his.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，欧洲“伊斯兰国”招募人员的物理近距离接触，是一种更有说服力的媒介，能把一个人变成愿意放弃他……

sentences.en: There aren't that many female attackers in Europe.
sentences.zh: 欧洲没有那么多女性袭击者。

sentences.en: His life.
sentences.zh: ……生命的袭击者。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So I was really struck by reporting in the Times and elsewhere after this attack in Manchester in which intelligence officials basically seemed to say,
